items.html: *Now, in Arich Anpin and Atik, the male took all the MA, and the female took all the BON, since she is sweetened and does not need him. But from Aba ve Ima onward, the males had to first take the BON of the female, even the smallness within her, in order to sweeten it, and afterward it was given to her completely, while its root from the smallness remained within them. And in greatness, he likewise takes his own and hers, and afterward the BON alone is given to her, for her Partzuf. And the MA — only its illumination, which is the illumination of the Hasadim alone, and not the root, for the root remains within him. And the opposite is so with the BON, for its root is within her, and within him there is only illumination. But nonetheless, since he took it first, he has a root greater than it, therefore his mind is complete. But the female takes from the MA only its illumination, and her root is from the BON, hence her mind is light even in greatness.
